freeze_status: H1 dataset/config frozen for review; candidate/runner/judge revisions will be pinned after H2-H4, before formal H5
grading_visibility: expected/expected_call/rubric, tags, family, and references are evaluator-only

metrics.accuracy: all 50 tasks; designated first Agent repeat; failed/timeout tasks count as failures
metrics.flip: mixed pass/fail vector over the 3 designated repeats
metrics.latency: candidate start through final answer or terminal failure; includes setup/tools/waits; excludes grader
metrics.p95_method: nearest_rank: sorted seconds[ceil(0.95*n)-1]; all completed terminal executions, not successful-only
metrics.pass_at_3: tasks with at least one pass among 3 / 50
metrics.tokens: candidate input+output across all calls; cached input is not counted twice; missing usage stays unknown
metrics.turns: all candidate model calls in the task including setup and follow-up

profile_semantics: Fictional self-reports. setup_messages execute before question in a fresh session per task/repeat; do not preload assistant answers or later user instructions.
source_semantics: Fact claims use pinned official records; snapshot_state observations describe catalog coverage, not universal university policies.
